description:
Acen Properties is delighted to introduce this impressive three-bedroom split-level penthouse apartment situated on the 14th floor of the prestigious Number One Bristol development,  in the heart of the city. The striking double-height living space creates an immediate sense of scale, while the east-facing aspect brings excellent natural light throughout the morning. Its elevated position provides far-reaching views across Bristol, with the living accommodation opening onto a private balcony – a fantastic space to sit outside and enjoy the city skyline. The living room also benefits from a built-in air conditioning unit, providing additional comfort throughout the warmer months.

 

Perfectly positioned in the heart of Bristol city centre, the apartment offers the convenience of having the city's shops, restaurants, cafés, bars, business districts and leisure amenities right on the doorstep, making it ideal for buyers looking to embrace city-centre living. The property offers three bedrooms and two generously sized bathrooms, with the third bedroom providing flexibility as a guest room or home office. A particularly rare advantage for such a central location is the inclusion of two parking spaces, while residents also benefit from an on-site gym and communal roof terrace. Cabot Circus and many of Bristol's key attractions are all within easy walking distance.

EPC Rating: C
